utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. Good morning, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, good morning, Mr. President. I'd like to introduce to the Chamber John Tso, from China, who is one of our legal interns who will be joining us this session. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Nicholls, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, everyone. Just before I start, if I could give an update on the schedule. We have tried to bring Professor Haglund back as soon as possible. As you know, before the break he had to go home, and we plan on having him testify on Monday. He will be available this coming Monday. I'm not sure exactly where we will be with Mr. Ruez at that point, but our plan would be to call Mr. Haglund on Monday morning and have him start and finish because he needs to get back to his other duties, and he had a window here where he could come and I've informed my friends of that. We would then, I anticipate, continue with Mr. Ruez, some cross-examination likely. Following him we would be calling Mr. Todorovic, KDZ351. He does not have protective measures. Followed by KDZ333, who I won't say the name because he does have protective measures. And lastly, it seems likely that we will not have a witness available today after Mr. Blaszczyk should he finish early.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Meaning that Mr. Ruez can only start tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes. I believe that is the case. I can check later in the day, but he came in, I believe, late last night.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you for that information. I take the Defence would appreciate it as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: We do, Mr. President. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Tieger.

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: And as long as we're dealing with such matters, if we could move briefly into private session for another housekeeping matter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Is it okay to proceed in the presence of Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: Oh, that's -- you're quite right. We can deal with this at the beginning of the session before -- beginning the next session before the witness comes in. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Further Examination by Mr. Nicholls: [Continued]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What I want to do now is as -- as efficiently as we can is move through the road book and the video and explain where the different places are.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I'll say for Your Honours and the Registry to make it -- it's a bit complicated because we will be showing videos and showing the road book at the same time. So Mr. Reid will bring up the pages of the road book rather than in e-court, because he is able to do that. So that's the way we plan on -- on proceeding now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We left off yesterday, you explained where we -- the OTP obtained the Petrovic Pirocanac raw video, which is the subject of the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'll ask Mr. Reid to please bring up -- we'll just go through the first few pages. This would be page 2 in e-court, the first map. And if we can quickly go to page 3, the next page, and page 4, the next page.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, quite simply, Mr. Blaszczyk, do these maps and the highlighted regions show the areas contained in the road book and on the video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This map contains the area when the video was recorded. This is area of Potocari, of course, Srebrenica, Zeleni Jadar and Kravica, Sandici, and Pervani. There is -- this map depicts the eastern part of Bosnia-Herzegovina, including Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. If we can go to the next page, which would be page 5 in e-court. If I'm right, this is simply an aerial image of the same areas?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This is correct. This is the aerial image on the same area. If we look at the map before, we see that it's covering the same area.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What does a star represent?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Sorry, Your Honour. You are referring to which star?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can we go back to -- you see a star in Srebrenica, and then shall we go back to the previous page.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No. This is -- represents the city, the towns. Ljubovija, Bratunac, Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Han Pijesak. Shall we go back to one page. Vlasenica, Han Pijesak, Zvornik. With stars.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What do those stars represent? We can go back one page further.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: If I may help, this is seats of municipalities.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. President, he's right. They represent municipalities.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So in Eastern Bosnia or, I don't know, Drina region, we have Bratunac, Srebrenica, Zepa. They are all municipalities.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. Sarajevo, then you have --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Karadzic. Let's continue, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: With just one correction. Zepa was not municipality but is ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And on page 5, Mr. Blaszczyk, simply this is an aerial image of the same highlighted regions?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We can go to the next page, page 6. It says chapter 1, Potocari. Can you tell us how you divided -- when you made this book, how you divided it into chapters, which chapters you picked?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This book is divided for five chapters. First chapter, this is Potocari. Then we have the second chapter, this is on the road. Area Sandici, Kravica, Pervani. Then we are -- we on chapter number 3, this is -- let me check. I believe this is Srebrenica chapter. Srebrenica town chapter. Number 4, this is Zeleni Jadar chapter, and number 5 this is Mosque Azemina chapter. It's on the suburb of Srebrenica if we are going towards Bratunac. I divided this book, you know, for these chapters because Mr. Petrovic during his travel in this area on the 13 and 14 of July 1995, he was on all this area -- areas. And from the video we are going to play we see -- we see these -- these particular areas.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. If we can go to the next page, page 7. Can you tell us what you -- what this page represents that you've created.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is more detailed map of -- of Potocari and -- Potocari area, and in this map you see that I plotted on this map few dots, just yellow dots with black dot inside, you know, and just marked them with number 1, 1A, 2A, 2B. This is the location. If we go to the following -- following pages we see the picture, you know, and the frames or just stills from the Petrovic video I located on this particular area and using GPS readings I spotted on the map.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Can we go to the next page, page 8. And here where it's hard to show both pages at once, but could you explain before we get to the video, Mr. Blaszczyk, how this photo works. If we look at page 8 on the left and page 9 on the right we see a still from the Petrovic video on the left and a photo taken on the right. Can you just explain how you put it together in this manner.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I try to organise this book --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sorry, one moment. Can we show page 9 on the screen now. We can bring up both. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I organise this book in this way, mostly in this way, that on the left-hand side of the book -- left-hand side page we have the still capture from the video, from the Petrovic video, and the right -- on the right-hand side page we have the picture taken by us of the same location spotted by us during our mission in May 2006. And as you see, Your Honours, I marked on -- on the page on the left-hand side, you know, just on the page 8 of the book I marked the picture as picture number A. And on the -- our picture on the page 9, I marked the same location what is depicted on the picture 8 as A. And below on the left-hand side, below the still capture from the Petrovic video, I marked the location -- I marked the location I mean the name -- name of the location and the position on the map, the map we saw the page before with this yellow circle with the black dot in. This position on the map is number 1. And we see on this picture on the frame and on my picture we see the same -- the same premises. This is DutchBat UNPROFOR base in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. We can blow-up the bottom on the left side. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And also -- also below the still captured from the video Petrovic I -- we put the time --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Yes, the position on map number 1 depicts the position 1 in the previous map.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So then, yes, as His Honour said, if we looked at the map on page 7 - we don't need to bring it up again - we see position 1 marked, and we look at page 8, the DutchBat base, we see that this is position on map number 1. Just before we move on, Mr. Blaszczyk, we see that the counter on the left-hand side, page 8, underneath the still photo is 00:37:13. What does that counter represent? What does that come from?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is counter of the time-code. This is time-code from the counter of -- of device we use to copy this -- this particular Petrovic raw video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And is it right that this counter is from the actual raw video-tape you provided to us at 37 seconds, in this case, frame 13 of that second?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, finally you said you used GPS. How were you able -- how familiar are you with this area? How often have you been to the areas in the map book and on the video, and how were you able to precisely locate and GPS these locations? What did you do to make sure you had the right places?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I've been in this area -- area many times and before -- before this mission in -- in May 2006, and -- and I'm quite familiar with this area, well familiar, I would say.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And even before -- before we decided to -- to spot it, all these locations, and get the GPS readings and get a proper photo of this location, I had a rough idea of where the location were, in fact. Before we went on the mission we just in May 2000 -- 2006, together with video assistant, we made the stills from the Petrovic video interested for us stills. We -- we printed out the stills. We took -- we brought a portable device to play the video itself, a good quality copy of the video, and we went to these places. We compared the stills from the Petrovic video, we compared the features of the terrain, you know, the make-up of the roads, the buildings, the location of the buildings, and looking at -- at these features we spotted the places. As soon as we spotted the place we took the GPS readings. We had a GPS with us.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And did you use two GPS devices in order to make sure you had the locations correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. We have -- as far as I remember, we had two. I had one, my own GPS, and my colleague had another one.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And I believe did you have a portable video player so you could play the video while you were at the locations?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, we did have.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And final question on that: Was I present for part of that mission?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. You were present in part of this mission.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now I'll ask Mr. Reid -- what I'd like to do now is start playing the raw video footage, P00667, and I'll ask you to stop when we get to the appropriate place. So we need to bring that up in Sanction, please. Sorry, just before that, Your Honours, the Sanction counter is about 4 seconds past what we see as the counter number in the video book. That is because the raw data video we captured was digitised and this was as precise a match as it was possible to achieve. If you put -- we found any video on a different DVD or CD player, it's often off by one or two seconds. So the numbers we see on Sanction will be consistently approximately 4 seconds past what we see in the book.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Start playing, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We stopped at 41.2 seconds in the Sanction presentation, which matches just about the photo depicted on page 8, photo A that we were talking about of DutchBat, the UNPROFOR base. Can you please tell us, Mr. Blaszczyk, where -- where is Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac and Mr. Borovcanin, in which direction are they travelling now? Where are they going?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac and Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin, together with their driver, they're travelling towards Srebrenica. They're passing by UN DutchBat now. We see the UN DutchBat location. It's almost reflect the same picture in my book, but on my book, on page 9, I mark the same location but with a little bit bigger perspective.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And just again, you've marked the directions of travel in each photo on the road book; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. Below -- below the stills from Petrovic video I mark in red arrows direction of Bratunac and Srebrenica, and we see when Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin are passing by, they're driving from Bratunac towards Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just again, what is the date?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is 13 of July, 1995.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If we could continue playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We've stopped at 54.2 in Sanction. And I'll ask Mr. Reid if he can also bring up page 10 of the book so we can compare. All right. And I'll ask Mr. Reid if he could pull up page -- yes. He's got it without me saying the photo.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. There we see the still of the men walking as you've got it in the book, and in the video how were you -- sorry, if we could now go to page -- the next page of the book, page 11. And you've marked the area below A and B and C where these photos were taken. How were you able to determine this location? Tell us where we are when this photo is taken.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are right now in -- in -- in the front of the main gate of the DutchBat and in the front of so-called white house. And this photo was taken from -- from the location exactly where Mr. Petrovic is standing in front of the white house in Potocari. It was very easy to -- to locate this place, because we see also the features and all of the features here, and if -- if we follow the video, we see what Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin stop the car, at least when Mr. Petrovic started to record his -- his material.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Let's keep playing then.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Can we see page 10.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I'm sorry. Yes. The right arrow says that's the Feros building. Is it near white house?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is across the road from the white house, Your Honour. This is -- we called it Feros building.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just across the white --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. If -- later on if we come to this digital presentation, I will really show it more closely.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It will be more visible for you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Please proceed, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could we keep playing the video, please, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And sorry, let's -- a little bit more. Stop. Thank you. We're at 1:02.9, a little bit past photo B on page 10. We can see the building behind where the civilians are walking, the women on one side, the men on the others.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could perhaps bring up the photo, Mr. Reid, photo B.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just very simply, can you tell us what building that is just behind the woman we see with the headscarf.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Feros administration building. Behind this building we -- we called it sometimes Blue Factory, but in the same compound. Feros Factory, but this is administration building of Feros company.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And if we could keep playing, please, to 1:23, approximately.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Mr. Blaszczyk, we've stopped at photo C, 1:23.1.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I think it may be easier, Mr. Reid, if we just have the still from the video we're playing, if we just have the Sanction video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've marked it as the woman is walking towards Bratunac; is that right? Can you just tell us briefly how you can tell which direction the people are walking in this video? I'm talking about the civilians, people in civilian clothing.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. We see here that Mr. Petrovic with his camera, he pass the road from -- from nearby the white house and he's on the -- in front of this Feros administration building and he's capturing -- he's recording the people who are walking on the left-hand side of the road, you know, just road leading from Bratunac to Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And if we could continue playing.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. The photo we now have -- the still we're at in the Sanction video at 1:38.1 corresponds to photo D. This is the same location, is that right, Mr. Blaszczyk, that you've plotted?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the same location on the left-hand side of the road leading from Bratunac to Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just to help get an overview, if I could have now in e-court 65 ter 03199. E-court page 16. All right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There we have an overview of Potocari, an aerial overview. Without you marking it, you see the Feros building marking and a spot marked the white house with a circle. Can you just tell us where -- and we see buses in this aerial. Where the people we just saw walking after Mr. Petrovic had stopped and gotten out of the car, which area was that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is area near to Feros building and to the white house. He was one -- one point he was on the -- on the hand right side of the road, you know, just near the white house, and then he passed the road and he's in the front of this Feros building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And just -- actually, could we -- I would like Mr. Blaszczyk to mark one point on this aerial. Not that -- if you wait a sec. We're going to get to an area in a minute called the Blue Building. Is that the same as the Blue Factory or a different building?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Your Honour, this is a different building. We called it Blue Factory. This belongs to this Feros company. And there is another building, we call it Blue Building. It at that time was coloured by blue -- is blue, in fact, but this is -- distance between these two -- two compounds is about 150, 200 metres, less even.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And if you can, can you just circle the area you called the Blue Building.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And you've marked that with a red circle, and we'll get to that building in a minute. Could we save that --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, I think I didn't locate this building inside the circle but --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could we erase --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- can I mark it again here?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could we erase that and start again, please.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And it's that rectangular building we can see inside the red circle?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Perhaps could you just write "Blue Building" next to that so it will be very clear when we look at this in the future what you've marked.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we ask Mr. Blaszczyk to -- to date and initial on this aerial image.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. I tender that, please, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That will be admitted as next Prosecution Exhibit.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4268, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, sorry, it's a bit complicated. If we could go back to Sanction, we'll keep playing the video. If could you play, please, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. We've stopped at 5:08.2. A few -- and if we could go to page 12 of the road book. All right. The still we're now at in the video 5:08.2 corresponds to photo B on page 12 approximately. This is position 2 in the photo book, Potocari, 50 metres north of the Express Bus Compound. First, can you just tell us who are the two men we see in the foreground, the man on the right wearing the blue UNPROFOR cap and the man on the left in a camouflage uniform.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The man with the blue cap, this is Dutch soldier, Dutch Officer van Duijn, and the man talking to him on the left-hand side, this is Mane Djuric. This is commander of the 1st Company of Jahorina Unit from Special Police Brigade of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And if we could just keep playing for a moment. Sorry, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And to be more clear, Your Honours, I noted here that this location is located 50 metres north of the Express Bus Compound, but a few minutes ago we talk about this Blue Building. This is exactly the Blue Building we have on the right-hand side if we're looking towards Srebrenica. This is in front, not in there, because Blue Building has this only yard and this is on the main road leading from Bratunac to Srebrenica. These two men, they are discussing exactly in this location in front of the yard of the Blue Building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. If we could keep playing for a moment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. We've now stopped at 5:23.3 on video we're playing, which is photo D on page 12. You've got the location mapped out on page 13 of the road book, the photo you took on mission.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If I could bring that up, please, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Now if you could just describe how you were able to tell that this is the correct location for the video segment we've just seen with Mr. Van Duijn and with this woman walking towards us in the picture we have now.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If you notice, Your Honour, this is on the picture D from the page 12 of my book. We see the check-point of -- of Dutch APCs over there, and we see the small -- small bridge. We can call it the small bridge, just small stream is coming behind -- under the bridge over there. On my photo on the page 13 I located this bridge, I mark here this bridge, and the building on the left-hand side on this photo from the page 13, this is new building. It not existed at that time in July 1995. It's a little different view. And, yes, and also the hill behind, in front of us, you know, is visible on the picture from the page 13 is not very clear on this picture D, but it is the same location.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And if we could continue playing now, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. We've stopped at 6:16.1 on the video. If we could show page 14 of the book. This corresponds closely to photograph C on that page. You've marked this the Blue Building. We've just seen Major Kingori walking here and this DutchBat officer. Just quickly, this is the same Blue Building, not Blue Factory that you circled a minute ago; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is Blue Building I referred to just a few minutes ago, and yard of this building, and, yes, we cannot mistake with Blue Factory which is located next to DutchBat. That Blue Factory is located -- is across the road about 100, 150 metres from this Blue Building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And if we could bring up page 15 now, the recent photo you used to determine this location. That's from your mission to create the road book. Is that the same building we see in photo 1 on page 15, it's the one we were just looking at?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is the same building. We can compare in the still from Petrovic video and this photo and we see that this is exactly the same building. It -- how this building looked in 2006. Now, it has been reconstructed and totally it looks different.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. If we can keep playing the video and see what Mr. Petrovic has filmed when he has now walked to the Blue Building location with Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped at 6:33.6, quite close to photo D on page 14 of the road book. The man in the foreground in the camouflage uniform with the black patch on his left arm, just for the record who's that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Ljubisa Borovcanin, deputy commander of the Special Police Brigade of Republika Srpska, at that time the commander of the police forces in this area.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We could continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We can't see much where I've stopped it at 7:52.3, but just to try to keep the route clear, we just saw the scene at the Blue Building where Major Kingori was discussing the place that was too crowded, where the men were sitting on each other, and now we see that he is walking with his camera and going somewhere else. Can we play, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Maybe go another frame or two until we get a clearer picture. Okay. We're now at 8:03.5 on the video. If I could bring up page 16 of the road book, please. Picture A. That's the still we have.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which location -- where are we now, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right now we are in the front of the white house. I marked this location when Mr. Borovcanin with -- with Dutch officer over there and interpreter is standing, and my picture from -- on the page 17 A and C, and in the background we -- on the left-hand side of this picture, picture 1 from the page 17, we see the white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And let's just keep playing a little bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped at 8:34.5.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Again, kind of across -- across the road from the white house; is that right? Not the Bratunac-Konjevic Polje road but the small access road.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This is across the small access road, this gravel road, narrow road.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Literally about 10 metres or 15 metres from -- from the gate of the white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And that corresponds to photo C on page 16. If we can keep playing now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We stopped at 8:51.2 on the video with the still image of the white house with a lot of bags in front and you can see part of the balcony. It's approximately the same as -- still as photo D on page 16. Just to be clear now can we bring up page 17, please, Mr. Reid, and just the whole page.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Just very simply this helps point out what you were discussing a minute ago. On page 17 of the road book, photos A and C which you've marked, that's the location - excuse me - where Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori and others were standing talking just across from the white house.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. And on the page -- page 2 -- on page 17, picture 2, we see the photo taken from the position of -- of where Mr. Borovcanin, Kingori, and others are standing in front of the white house. This is Feros building.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. If we could keep playing the video now, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We need to go back, Mr. Reid. All right. We're starting at 8:50.7. If we could play now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And stop at 9:05.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, during that segment, this is what is depicted as we received the raw video from Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is the segment from -- from the raw material given to us by -- by Mr. Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could we go back a little bit, Mr. Reid, to the -- keep going. Keep going. Stop. Forwards. Okay.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 8:51.8 we see a big shell casing. Have you seen that shell before in this scene we see here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I saw this shell. This shell was shown to me by Mr. Petrovic in -- in February 2006 when we conducted interview with him. The shell was located at his -- his home, on the balcony of his home. In fact this is shot from his house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now let's play -- I'm going to now play, Your Honours, a bit of video not from the raw footage but from the Studio B documentary, which is P01193.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you tell me the exhibit number again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I had the --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If you give me one minute, Your Honour. This is actually in the trial video. Sorry. I need one moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. I confirm that the number you have given, i.e., P1193, is that Studio B footage.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] Yes, Your Honour. It's just we're trying to find it in Sanction. I'll play P0666. And if we can go back and just get that ready. That is a split screen. You can stop for one second.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, I think you helped create this video. If you can explain it to us, please, which shows footage of the white house that was obtained from the Studio B documentary on one side and Mr. Petrovic's raw video that he provided to us on the other side. Before we play it, can you just tell us a little bit what we're going to see?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Together with my colleague video assistant we tried to create exactly the location on the raw footage where -- where this -- the frames from the Studio B were recorded, and we compared to part of -- one part -- two part of the videos, one from the Studio B and another one from -- from the raw material. We were able to -- to spotted the places where -- where the material from -- when the footage from raw material was over-recorded. And if we play these two footages together, we will see exactly where -- where was -- where and how it was over-recorded, you know, on the raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Now I understood. This P666 was one of the associate exhibits that we admitted into evidence together with Petrovic's 92 bis statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. If we could play that, please, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I've just stopped for a moment at 11.1.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And we can see -- it's a little bit hard to see, but is that the Studio B logo we see on the left frame, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is logo of Studio B television in Belgrade.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the words running below on the left, that's actually advertising from when this documentary was broadcast in Belgrade; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: That is correct. It is Serbian language, some advertising not connected to this particular video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And on the right-hand side, that's the raw video from Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac that he provided us.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, on the right-hand side we have the footage from the raw material from Mr. Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we can play now, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we have this transcript, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I see the transcript in hard copy, page -- last four digits 7892 in the transcript, but I don't know where we can find it in e-court. Can you help us, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What I said is last four digits. It's just simple. It reads as it is written here: "There were some people who tried to smuggle themselves onto a convoy and who are registered criminals."

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It's e-court page 274, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I don't know whether -- where is the Serbian version. It's -- it should be there. Shall we continue, or shall we begin from the -- from the beginning?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We could play it one more time, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I should say that P01193, which is admitted, unfortunately we had trouble bringing it up, that I intended to play does have the transcript synced with it. So it's available there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Let's play this one more time, this clip, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We can stop there. Mr. Blaszczyk, we saw a two-second blank on the one side. That was also as the original as we received it; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, what was -- did you ask Mr. Petrovic about his explanation for why the scene of the balcony with the men on it now had a -- on the raw material we had a shell casing from his balcony?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course I did ask him. We did ask him during our interview why -- why it happened. He explained situation that he was very unexperienced to operate the camera and coincidentally and not intentionally he over-recorded this material when he returned to home. And he doesn't know exactly. He -- his explanation was that he's not able to tell, you know, how it happened and why it happened.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But the scene of the men on the balcony, just to be clear, is completely absent from the raw material he gave us.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This footage is not -- not -- not on the raw material handed over to us, and if we compare the time-code from the raw material, we see that originally there is missing about 11 seconds of recordings.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. What I'd like to do now is have you show to us and to the Trial Chamber the interactive CD presentation that was created which shows this chapter, Potocari. If we could go through it quickly and let me know if you need a minute to set that up.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Your Honour, this is presentation we prepared just for better understanding of Petrovic video of location where that video was recorded. I will try to explain how we can operate with this presentation and how we go in. If we -- on the -- on the bottom of this picture we have few -- few buttons over here. We can zoom button here. We can blow-up little bit the picture. Zoom out and go -- this one is go -- is back to the -- the previous page, if we need to use that one. This one which mark the places which is the linkage to another page or photo or photos or image from Petrovic video. If we open this first page, if we go to the first page we see again the map of Bosnia-Herzegovina, and if you like -- would like to go to the area -- the Eastern Bosnia area, to Bratunac/Srebrenica area, we can press this -- this field, and we again we are in the next map. Coming closer, we are in -- in much detail map of area of Srebrenica, Bratunac, Konjevic Polje, but before I go in, I would like to tell that this presentation contains only two segments of Petrovic video, the most significant segments. This is segment of Potocari and segment of Kravica, Sandici, and Pervani area. Right now we passed -- we -- we were through the Petrovic video of chapter 1 of Potocari. Then let's go to Potocari. And we have map -- more detailed map of the area of Potocari. We're marked some -- some arrows here. And again if you'd like to get in to linkage to the photos from my trip to Bosnia or to the image from Petrovic video, we have to go to -- to these fields, but knowing where the fields are can be activated -- we can use this button.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you could maybe just take us through quickly and show us the different places that we've just seen on video, how you can find them in this presentation.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Let's go to the first place. We are in the front of the white house now. We can move around. We can see entire area. If we go -- if we mark this -- the field here where the -- if you remember, Your Honours, where Mr. Kingori, Borovcanin, and others were talking in -- near, we see the image from Petrovic video. And also if you would like to zoom in, we can do that. Going back --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you go back to the first page again, kindly. Cover page.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Cover page. Of course, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you tell me again how you turn the page?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Just pressing the button of the mouse. You know, just -- if you --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Oh, yes. Okay. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Your Honour, if you want to know where to press the button, it's perfect if you use this help button here, marking the area when -- when you have linkage to another photos, map, or other Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But it's correct that in the beginning if you just click anywhere on the cover page, it brings you into the presentation and then into highlighted area.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I think it's only the first page. You know, the cover page is linkage to the presentation itself. Let's go back to the area of -- we are again in front of the white house. We saw already Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori talking in front of the white house. This is the footage from raw material of Mr. Petrovic. We are coming back. We can enter. We can go in here. Also if you like to see which area we need to click to be linked to another picture or photo we can use this button. We are in the front house. You know, this is also image from Petrovic video, it's from his raw material, and the picture taken in 2006. If we click on the balcony here, we are getting image from -- from Studio B's -- mark of the Studio B is very visible here on the right-hand side on the top of this picture. We can close-up to the balcony. We see the people sitting on the balcony. One more time, we have the closest view of these people.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are back to the picture from 2006. And as I said, if we would like to see the view from -- from the Feros building, let's go to the other side of the road using this button. In fact, we see the Feros building from -- from this location. This is the Feros building here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Seen from the white house?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. We have the Feros building, the blue -- we call this Blue Factory but belonged to Feros company behind. And DutchBat and road leading towards Bratunac. Here at that time it was the main gate of and check-point of DutchBat. Again we have a linkage here to the photo from Petrovic raw material. We see the Feros building behind, the Feros administration building behind. If we move up, we are in direction to Srebrenica now. If we -- yeah. This is -- this is also footage from Petrovic video. Approximately it was taken in this -- this location on the right-hand side of the road leading from Bratunac to Srebrenica. You see the man working on the right, right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And again, Mr. Blaszczyk, if I could stop you for a minute. If you go back one frame to the overview. You were able to determine, I think you said, the location of these photos by the Feros building on the one side where the people are walking, and if you turn the other -- keep scrolling to the right, the topography of the mountains you can see behind in some of the videos; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. If you could just show us the other links in the Potocari part.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Uh-huh. This is another side of the road also, road leading -- if we look straight we are faced towards Srebrenica and we see people walking on the left-hand side of the road. And we can move closer to the blue -- Blue Building and the check-point containing -- check-point of DutchBat APCs. You should remember, Your Honours, this picture from the book but more wider picture in panorama picture. This building is -- this was built after the war. It didn't exist in July 1995. Behind this new building we see the part of the bus compound here. We see the footage from July 1995 recorded by Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And again that -- what you just showed us, if you can scroll back, is the area with that small bridge or drainage ditch and the check-point we saw.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's hard really to see it, but I'm standing probably on this bridge now taking the photo.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And again, Your Honour, if -- these arrows mark the area or the field, you can link to another photos, but if you would have -- or if anybody would have a problem to find additional linkage fields, you can use this button and this mark here. Let's go back. We are in the map, map of Potocari. Now we are in front of -- in the yard of the Blue Building. We see the Blue Building. This building is located about 100 metres from the white house, and on the same side of the road. The white house is not visible here, but it's visible Feros administration building and the blue -- Blue Factory, Feros company behind is, as I said, about 100, 150 metres. I check the linkage here. If you remember, we see the APC, part of the APC and the Dutch soldiers. And behind we also see the DutchBat and part of the Blue Factory. Another linkage, we see here Mr. Beara and Mr. Kingori. They are on the yard of Blue Factory exactly in this location.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can I stop you one second. I think I heard you say that last -- could you bring that --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I realised. That's not Blue Factory, of course. This is Blue Building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And I think I heard you say Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you bring up the photo you just showed us of the men with Mr. Kingori. Yeah. Who is that, with the black patch?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Did I say Mr. Beara? No, this is Mr. Borovcanin. Mr. Borovcanin, of course.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue, just show us the rest of the links here.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are again in the yard of the Blue Factory -- Blue Building. And behind this Blue Building here we see -- we see power plant, electrical station of -- of -- behind this electrical station is also behind of -- of white house. Let's go to the footage from July 1995, 13 July 1995. We are again in the yard of the Blue Building. We see the tractor with water tank. One more general view of the area. Let's go back to the view. I think we were here already. And we're again in the front of the white house. Across the road we have the Feros building. And this is presentation regarding Potocari and events in Potocari from July 13, 1995.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And we can --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We can leave that now. And just to be clear, these -- the photographs used in the presentation you've just shown us are the same ones used in the road book, stitched together, taken at the same time.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. This is -- I think each photograph is taken during our mission in -- in May 2000 -- 2000 -- 2006. The photograph in -- of Potocari, yeah, yeah. And also we -- you see the same photos or very similar photos in our road book.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So then just to confirm what we saw in this segment of video and in the book was Mr. Pirocanac coming in past the UN DutchBat base, stopping and being out of the car by the Feros building, walking by the check-point --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: -- being at the Blue Building and then going to the white house. Is that the correct sequence?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct sequence. The first footage of Mr. Pirocanac being in Potocari, not driving in Potocari but being in Potocari we have in the front of the white house, in front of the Feros building. He's entering the bus with the people in, and he's walking towards Blue Building, recording some events and some conversation or -- in -- in front of -- at the check-point place, then on the yard of the Blue Building, returning again to the white house. Location of the white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could go back to playing the video now, please. The raw video. We can start just about where we left off at 9:04.6, and if we can play.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And stop, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, just before we -- that is the end of the Potocari segment we just saw on the 13th of July; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is correct. This is the end of the Potocari segment.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could I now have - we can do this before the break - page 20 of the road book, chapter 2. And go to the next page, please, page 21.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is the next sequence of footage we're coming to that was shot by Mr. Pirocanac at that day. We've got the map here of the locations that you plotted with the GPS from your trip. Just before we begin watching the video, can you tell us what this -- what this area is that -- that appears on video we're about to see, the locations, and just quickly tell us which way the car was travelling and when it turned around.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is area of Sandici, Pervani, and Lolici, and Kravica. We see the footage -- the first footage that Mr. -- Mr. Pirocanac together with Mr. Borovcanin, they are in Sandici, in Sandici meadow, and then are driving towards Konjevic Polje. They are following two APCs -- in fact, one APC and one BOV and one Praga, and they are returning to Sandici meadow and they are driving towards Kravica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And can we just -- before we begin playing the video, I think it would be helpful go to the next page of the book, please, page 22. We'll start off near Sandici meadow when we watch the video. It's a little bit of a complicated scene so can you just tell us about this large picture you took which set it out and the locations you've marked.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is overview picture of the area of Sandici meadow. We took this picture from the hill above the Sandici meadow, and I plotted here -- I just connected -- I showed here the location of destroyed white house opposite the road of the Sandici meadow and destroyed house in Sandici meadow itself. On the right -- left-hand side of the picture on the top we have the -- the close-up of the picture of the destroyed white house across the road, and on the right-hand side on -- on the top we have destroyed house in Sandici. These houses -- these two houses would be visible on the Petrovic video. When we play the Petrovic raw material we see these houses and -- in this video. And we have general view of the Sandici meadow. We see the road leading from -- I marked the direction here Konjevic Polje and Kravica-Bratunac, and somebody who never been there can -- can see, you know, which direction we are going to.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the ...

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Continue, please. Continue, please, if you had something.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And opposite like in the previous pages, you know, I didn't -- this page didn't follow by the -- in fact, this page on the left-hand side is not the -- not the picture from Petrovic video, but I tried to -- to make it as easy as possible to understand the area over there. And on the page 23 we have close-up of -- of destroyed white house. We have Sandici meadow and we have also panorama picture of the road including the destroyed white house.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And that's page 23. If we could bring it up for one minute for the public to see what you've just described.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. I see it's almost the break. I'm going to play some video now but I'd rather just start playing it and play it through rather than play two minutes and stop, if I may.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. But I just wonder if we could take the break now rather than start the video.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, we'll do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll take a break for half an hour and resume at 11.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Now we're going to start with chapter 2 of the book entitled "On the road." It begins at Sandici. I'll just say for the record, in the trial video book, P04202, there are some stills from this beginning at page 98 of the hardcover, page 137 in e-court, which identifies some of the people we're see on the video. I don't propose to stop and identify each person as we go along, but that's where it can be found. The transcript for this section begins in the same exhibit at e-court page 274.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, to begin with, could we just -- before we start playing, just show page -- the next two pages of the road book, pages 24 and 25, to orient ourselves. That's up on the screen now. And, Mr. Blaszczyk, the still from the video on the left, which is from page 24, shows a man in camouflage uniform standing in front of the small destroyed house, and on the photo at the right, the one taken on your mission, there's a man, I believe it's you, standing in front of the same destroyed house, and an image on right showing where we are. So just to be clear, and correct me if I am wrong, but this image where we begin is now kind of right in the middle of Sandici meadow; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is right in the Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And you've marked that as position 5 on the map for this chapter?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. If you go back to the map, it's marked as number 5.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Mr. Reid, if we could now start playing the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can we stop, please. Go back one frame.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped at 10:22.6. I just wanted to stop here, Mr. Blaszczyk, because we've got the date stamp 13 July 1995 on the original raw video. Just to ask you, is that the right date?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this is the right date. 13 July 1995.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And we don't need to bring them up now, but you've marked this man who is calling out to his son and the location on pages 26 and 27 of the road book; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. On the page 26 we have stills from Petrovic video. And on page 27 we have my photos with marked location or spotted location where the man was standing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: How do we know he's calling his son, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Perhaps I shouldn't have said that. I believe that's from some other evidence, Your Honours. I'll strike that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Can you just tell us what that part we saw is, Mr. Blaszczyk, with no picture but just a recording of Mr. Petrovic talking about himself?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is -- according to Mr. Petrovic, this is his conversation with somebody on the phone, and it was recorded at his -- his apartment or house in Belgrade. It's over-recorded for the original material.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. So again, he's recorded over a portion there that we don't have.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, if we could keep playing, please. We're at 11:16.6.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop, please. We stopped at 11:50.4, after seeing Mr. Borovcanin speaking with two armed men about swapping pistols. I'll ask Mr. Reid if we can now bring up pages 30 and 31 of the road book.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And we saw the camera at the end pan from Mr. Borovcanin and these two men back to Sandici meadow. Can you tell us how you determined where they are? Where is this conversation taking place with Commander Borovcanin?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we would play this video again in slow motion, we could see even the part of the destroyed white house which is located across the -- the road from Sandici meadow, and watching carefully the move of the camera, I easily could -- could -- could locate the place where Mr. Borovcanin is talking to these two -- two men. One is from the -- from the Special Police Brigade, another one from PJP Company.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And on page 31 of the map book, you've marked A and B, the location where this conversation took place?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. I can be wrong, but my mistake would be in one matter, two matters, maybe, but no -- no more.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. I'll -- since you suggested it, I'll ask Mr. Reid to play that clip again. I don't know that we can play it in slow motion, but we'll just play it to show the proximity of Mr. Borovcanin and these men to the prisoners.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It was a little bit early.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Go back again, Mr. Reid, sorry.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop here? Yeah. This is --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we can go back two frames. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: You -- just above Mr. Borovcanin's head we see -- I believe this is the part of the wall of white house, destroyed white house. And later on when we -- you follow the move of the camera, you -- you could see the road, the main road, and also part of the Sandici meadow. And just taking into consideration all this movement and this feature, I located this spot.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And we're at 11:34.7, where you say there's a small portion of the white house we can see.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we can play, please, again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop there, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And we'll just do this quickly. If we could look at page 32 and 33 of the road book. Yeah. Here you've marked just the section of Sandici meadow where these men were gathered just before the camera once again went black; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. This is on page 33. We have the panorama picture of Sandici meadow, and I marked the location where the men were gathered.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the photo on page 33 is approximately taken with the photographer's back to the white house. Is that about right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. The photos was taken on the side of the road where the destroyed white house is located. Just -- we do the photo from -- it was several photos, just matched together.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. And, Your Honours, on page 32, photo B, there's a typo in the counter code. It should be 11:44.10, not 11:54.10. I apologise for that. If we could continue playing the video now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. We don't need to go back to the still. We can stop. We don't need to go back to the still. This area's on page 34 and 35 of the road book, marked as map position 9.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you just tell us approximately where this is taking place in relation to Sandici meadow and what we saw in this picture of the guns firing into the woods.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This footage was recorded about 200 -- 2.800 metres from Sandici meadow, on the road leading towards Konjevic Polje, and we see on this -- this footage we see one Praga and one BOV, the armed vehicles of Special Police Brigade, Sekovici Detachment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just quickly, how were you able to determine this location heading towards Konjevic Polje now from Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, it wasn't difficult. Just looking at the features of the terrain especially of the road and the hills, surrounding hills, we could easily determine the place where the footage was recorded.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We'll keep playing now.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop here?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We stopped at 13:23.9.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And it's not mentioned here in my road book, but it's visible on the video. If you look at the smoke coming out from the forest after the shelling, we see the people moving around. We just see the shape of the men, probably of the men. If you look very carefully on it. But we should play it again. It's not visible now. The quality is not so good now in this version, but if you play, we see that these men is -- or whoever it is just moving.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can you go back just a tiny bit, Mr. Reid. Yeah. We're at 14:13.1 in the video. That picture approximately is shown on page 36 of the road book in picture B. It's off by a tiny amount. And if we look at page 37 of the road book, if we could, Mr. Reid, picture A1. And we see a house and a sloping hill behind it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Were you able -- just tell us how -- where we are now in this location still and how you were able to tell where we are.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see that these two -- two vehicles moved towards Konjevic Polje about 300 metres. It's also Pervani, Pervani area. And, yes, I spotted the houses, which is also recorded by Mr. Pirocanac here. If you look at my picture from the page 37, it is -- maybe it doesn't look the same, but is -- is the same house re-builded after the war, and looking also at the features of the terrain, as I said, at the hills and the road and the location of the houses and their relation to the other houses, we could easily spot the place where the -- the footage was recorded.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, did you say page 57 or it's 37?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thirty-seven. Sorry, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I'm sorry?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thirty seven, Your Honour, 3-7.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Picture A on page 37. Correct, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's correct. This is picture A on the page 37. We have the same -- the same house depicted on the still from Petrovic video on the page 36 as marked here as -- as still A.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So what we're seeing is Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin have left Sandici meadow, heading along the road towards Konjevic Polje, stopping occasionally and filming this firing into the woods.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is quite correct. Just we see that Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Pirocanac, they are following these two APCs along the road. In Pervani. This place is located, according to our measurement, about 3 -- 3.000 metres from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. If we could continue playing the video, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Mr. Blaszczyk, did you say Mr. -- Mr. Pirocanac was following these two APCs along the road?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, because we -- we hear the voice even coming from -- in fact, we know that it's coming from the car of Mr. Borovcanin and -- and Mr. Pirocanac, and we know also from other witnesses, including Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac, that they -- they follow these two APCs at the beginning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. If we could play now, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped now at 16:39.2. This is a shot -- a still from video which was clearly filmed from inside of the car, from the front passenger side, while the car was being driven. If we could look, Mr. Reid, at pages 38 and 39 of the road book. For now just page 39.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: On page 38 we've got the stills A and B which correspond to where we stopped the video. This is map position 11 you've marked on your map on page 21 of the road book. And I can see from the way you've marked the road directions in -- on pages 38 and 39 that the car now appears to be heading back towards Sandici and Bratunac. In other words, the opposite direction of the video we saw up to this point. Is that -- it's a long summary. Is that -- is that correct? Which direction now are Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin travelling?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. You are right. The car is now heading towards Sandici meadow again. This is the first footage which we see that the car made a U-turn and heading towards Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And were you able to determine the precise location of the U-turn from watching the video or not?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I wasn't able to do it, because I -- as you see here, the images on this page 38, the stills from Petrovic video, these two houses are located about 1.000 metres, you know, just from the previous location when we saw the Praga and BOV shooting towards the hills, but as far as I remember from interview of Mr. Petrovic, they drove towards Konjevic Polje. They made a U-turn, I think, in Konjevic Polje, but I was not able to determine the place where they made this U-turn on this video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. And so just to be clear for the map book, from Sandici meadow up to map position 10, which we saw on the previous pages, the direction of travel is towards Konjevic Polje. At some point there's a U-turn, and from map position 11 as we continue now it's back towards Sandici meadow. They've made a -- they're returning to where we started.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is -- this is correct. From -- from -- from 11 on the map this is direction towards Sandici and Kravica, in fact.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And very simply, we see some houses on page 38 and 39. Did that assist you in locating where we see this conversation taking place in the car as you've marked it on the map book.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this house, especially this one help me to locate -- spotted this location, and this is the house marked here as house B here. This is the house -- I believe this is that one from the -- from the picture, from the still from Petrovic video. And at the beginning I wasn't so sure, you know, just whether this is the proper house or not, but I talked to the owner of this house and renovated house next to this destroyed house, and I showed him the footage, the stills from the Petrovic video and he confirmed that these two houses belonged to his family.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And, of course, the features of the -- the terrain and the road. Which is another confirmation.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And now if we'll continue playing now the footage as we return to Sandici meadow direction.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sorry, just a quick question. We see Mr. Borovcanin speaking here about stopping the traffic, and we saw a reference to Bor. Whose's nickname is Bor, if you know?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Borovcanin, Ljubisa Borovcanin, he used the nickname Bor. Or the other people used to call him as Bor on the radio.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: You can play, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes? Continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And I think we have confirmation because when we saw the previous footage, they went to these two brothers who were dealing with the pistol, showing the pistol to Mr. Borovcanin, one of them called him also Bor, if I could remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes. If we could play, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: This one is very hard to capture. We stopped at 17:06.3. On page 40 of your book, we see the still at photo A, and if we were to continue for just a few seconds, in position A we see a man with a rifle and another man. We can see actually where we stopped at 17:06.3, further down, two soldiers. Again this is map position 12 on pages 40 and 41. We'll keep playing, but how were you able to determine this location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is again, like in the previous cases, just looking at the -- at the features of the terrain. But looking at this retaining wall, in this area near Sandici meadow there are two retaining walls from Sandici meadow towards the direction of Konjevic Polje. This is one of these -- these retaining walls. Later on we should see another one.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And how far now is Mr. Petrovic and Borovcanin from Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are about 900 metres from Sandici meadow. Mr. Borovcanin heading from Konjevic Polje direction towards Bratunac and, of course, Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We stopped at 17:48.7.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This still we've stopped at, the frame corresponds to page 42 of your road book, photo C, again filming from the car. We can see a soldier crouching just over the mirror, the rear-view mirror of the car. These are positions on your map, 13, 14, 15. The other soldiers I didn't stop at. How far are we now from -- or we're getting closer to Sandici meadow; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. We are getting closer to Sandici meadow. We about 400 matters from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I ask Mr. Reid to bring up page 43 of the road book. And if we can perhaps make that larger, the road book page. That's good. And I think in hard copy it's easy to see.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've marked -- just so we can see, does this show us where these soldiers are lined up along the road, the same road where we saw firing into the hills coming from earlier in relation to Sandici meadow, the destroyed white house, and you've also marked in the small inset photo the Kravica warehouse. Can you confirm that and tell us just a little bit about how far these distances are from here to the Kravica warehouse?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can confirm it. It's not visible here on this picture, of course, it's too small one, but if we zoom -- zoom in this picture, you know, we can -- we could see also Kravica warehouse. It's very visible from Sandici meadow. It's -- the location of Kravica warehouse in relation to the Sandici meadow, the distance is about 900 metres, 1 kilometre at the most. 900 metres, I would say.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And there's one -- on page 43, one area marked with a white X. It's not a -- can you just tell us what that location indicates.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In such way I marked the position or the location when -- where the Bosnia Federal Commission for Missing Persons made exhumation of 70 bodies. It was June 2004. The bodies were dumped behind this barrier. There is a small stream going along this road.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Let's continue playing. From 17:48.7 we'll continue playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped at 18:06.08.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is shown on photo B of page 46 of the map book, and you've marked it as position 17, 17A. On page 47 of the map book, A and B, you've marked where this man calling for people to come out of the woods is.
