If you just tell us now how -- how close is this to -- well, we could -- how close is this to Sandici meadow? We can see on the photo on page 47 the approximate location.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This place is visible from Sandici meadow itself and is located about 200 metres from Sandici meadow. On page 47 I tried to -- to make it clear as much as possible, you know, just to -- to point out this -- this particular location and relation to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. So this just shows us the location of where some of the soldiers are arranged along the road by Sandici meadow where they're calling out to the prisoners to surrender.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. They are members of Special Police Brigade, Jahorina Unit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just if I can look at the bottom photo, photo 2 on page 47. That's that big panoramic photo. The way the road is so curved there, is that accurate or is that distorted a bit from putting the pictures together?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This picture, in fact, is a little bit distorted, and we tried to merge this picture, you know, as much as possible to reflect the real situation, but it's a little bit distorted, you know. The road is more straight. If you are planning to visit this area it would be very visible.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing now, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop here?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stopped at 19:31.8.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You asked us to stop, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, if you pay attention to the hill, you will see the people moving.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which people?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I mean Muslim population.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can we back up just a bit, Mr. Reid, and we'll play again. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. I stopped us at 20:13.1 on the video. The photo there, it's a little bit blurry on the frame we're on, but it corresponds to photo C on page 48 of the map book.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've marked this as position map 18. Again, now about 150 metres from Sandici meadow; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. In the vicinity of Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And they've stop the car and are walking around, obviously. And just again, it's a bit blurry on the frame, but is this Mr. Borovcanin we see on the screen on the far left?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. On the left-hand side I see Mr. Borovcanin here. And these two men on the right-hand side, they're members of 1st Company of PJP, CJB Zvornik.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And I won't bring it up to save time, but I'll just say on page 49 of the road book, with these photos we can see that this is just up the curve of the road, nearly now back to Sandici meadow and the white house where we started this -- seeing this section of the film by Mr. Petrovic. We can keep playing now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We're at 21:03:7. That corresponds nearly identically to photo B on page 50 of the map book, now a hundred metres or just a little bit closer to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know who these men are?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These two men, they are members of Jahorina Company of the Special Police Brigade.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. And we saw them pointing their rifles down, downwards, and Mr. Petrovic filmed just down towards the ground through some trees and we heard some running water. What's down there, and why are they -- what is in that direction from this part of the road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic filming here little bit stream and they're waiting for -- expecting some Muslims coming down from -- from the hills through these bushes towards the -- the road how they were called by -- by the Serbs.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. And I won't bring it up to save time, but you've marked this clearly on page 51 of the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Let's keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We've stopped now at 21:12.9 in the video. This corresponds to photo B on page 52 of the road book. The location's marked as now about 50 metres from Sandici meadow, getting closer.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've marked it on page 53 as well. I just wanted to stop here. Is that Mr. Borovcanin we see talking to the soldier wearing the blue helmet?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this is correct. This is Mr. Ljubisa Borovcanin talking to this soldier with the blue helmet, but we see that this is member of Special Police Brigade. If you look at the left arm is visible -- I believe this is visible badge of Special Police Brigade. We saw this similar badge on the arm of one of the brothers with the gun.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And which force would these blue helmets belong to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The blue helmet itself, not to the Serb forces but definitely this is not Serbian equipment. It belonged, I believe, to UNPROFOR. And we see also the man next to the car, just looking by the white car. This is the car used by Mr. Borovcanin, Mr. Pirocanac Petrovic, and the man just getting in the car or getting something from the car, he's his driver Nedjo Jovicic, I believe.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. And again what you've just described we can see on page 52 of the road book. It's the same in e-court, page 52. Photograph B.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We're at 21:56.8 of the video. It's an almost perfect match with photo C on page 54. Just before this man with the back-pack and the dark jacket, we saw a man in a white shirt and two men, one of them helping the other, walking up this path uphill towards where this man is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could we go to page 55, please, of the road book where you have marked out the path or route taken by these Muslim men as they come out of the woods up towards Sandici meadow. Can you just tell us how you figured it out.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. I tried to -- I tried to establish the pattern of how the people were coming out from the woods and from the hills to -- to Sandici meadow, and also looking at the features of the terrain, looking at the white house, destroyed white house behind the road and checking out the features of this house, and checking how the people were getting the road, it's visible that this is this location, exactly this location.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: If we play later on we see more details of the destroyed white house including the pillars. And entire white house, I believe.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. And if we look at where we stopped, the men rounding a corner, which is photo C on page 54, you've marked that -- it's hard to see on the screen we've got. On page 55, as he's just at the corner of the white house; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. It is on the bottom -- on the page 55, the picture number 3, I've marked as his position C here and also on the first picture from the same page 55, and C, where the man is passing by the corner of this building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. And just to be clear, if I can go back one second, the hills we see behind the white house on the right side of the road if you're heading towards Kravica/Bratunac, that's the same side of the road or is it a different side of the road that we saw the Pragas and the firing going on into the woods?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the same side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Let's keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, can we back up a bit to -- I should have told you, Mr. Reid. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We're at 23:05.9, approximately the same as photo F on page 56 of your book. You talked about the white columns. These men who were coming up, walking up the hill and rounding this white pillar, can you tell us where this is and how you were able to determine it.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. These -- these pillars, this is the western part of the destroyed white house. I reconstructed the path of these men, how they were walking, and we see this on page 57, and the pillars are the same. I think they're more visible on the page before even.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And could we bring up page 56, please, Mr. Reid. And just make that larger. We'll leave it as it is. Your Honour, could we go into private session for one moment?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. We are now in open session.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Let's keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And stop. I need to go back to it. We just saw a one-second photo from Mr. Karadzic on TV.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know why that's there -- was there?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. As Mr. Petrovic explained during his interview, he says that it was over-recorded or even it's possible that he used the old tape and this very short footage of Mr. Karadzic is -- is just from another event, another interview, whatever, just that he says that [indiscernible] this is not the part of -- of this trip.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: He said that was -- inadvertently that he has that piece on there?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Play, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We stopped at 23:50.4. Corresponds a little bit zoomed in to page 58 of the road book, photo C.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The point I wanted to see if you can make clear here, Mr. Blaszczyk, is the man we saw in the black leather jacket who walked up out of the woods, asked for some water and crossed the road. He's coming, we saw, around the corner from the white house. Where is he going now across road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's crossing the road and going to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And on page 59 I just reconstructed the path he used.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And so just to be clear, behind this group we see here picking up a man who is either injured or dead or something, picking somebody up, is that the slope which leads up to Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. And I believe we see these people taking this man also in the previous footage.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We can keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Can we stop? We're at 24:20.3. We'll keep playing, but we see "French Army NATO approved" box and we'll play in a minute. Just on the transcript we see the portion we just finished. I won't go back to it, but what we heard coming through on the tape was an unknown man saying, "Laser 2 is calling you." Do you remember -- do you know who Laser 2's call-sign was, who that belonged to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't remember right now whose -- whose code-name it was. I think it was Borovcanin's code game, but I'm -- I believe this is Borovcanin. I believe this is Borovcanin code-name.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, the video we just saw of the food rations box, do you have any -- do you know why that is suddenly there on the video? It has nothing to do with Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this part of the video has nothing to do with Sandici meadow. This part was recorded over after that. According to the explanation of Mr. Pirocanac, it wasn't intentionally, but anyway, it was over-recorded. We later on just sure that this part of the video should also contain the footage we saw in Studio B, the footage of Kravica warehouse and bodies in the front of Kravica warehouse. And this ration portion, the French ration portion, it's also visible that it was recorded over at -- it was recorded at the house of Mr. Pirocanac, because I recognise the typing machine, I think, I believe I saw at his house.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you know of any explanation from him about why - just while we're here - about why that box appears?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was coincidence. According to Mr. Petrovic, of course.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: What I'd like to do now is play a portion of the Studio B video. This is not from the raw footage. This is from the documentary Studio B. It's on our trial video at P4 --- P4201. For our record, this is part 3 of the trial video. It should be at 36 to 37:05. If we could play that, this Studio B section, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. And we'll now play that again just in slow motion because it is such a quick little clip. If you could play that, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'll stop that at 36:36.3.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: As you said, Mr. Blaszczyk, you'd already said this is not on the raw video footage shot by Mr. Pirocanac that he provided to us. This is on the Studio B broadcast. Do you know where this location is? Do you have any doubt about where this location is that we see in front of us, the bodies in front of this building?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am sure that we are in front of Kravica warehouse and we see the bodies in front of the Kravica warehouse. We see the western door of the first Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Let's keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop, please. Stopped at 36:48.8. Now if we can look at pages 60 and 61 of the road book. I don't know, Mr. Reid, if you can also bring up -- can you bring up page 60 on the left? Is that possible? If we leave the video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. So on the left we have page 60 of the road book with the two stills from Studio B. You've marked this as map position 20 in Kravica. And on the right we have the photos taken on your visit there, on page 61, and you've marked the directions of the road, Bratunac and - excuse me - Sandici, Konjevic Polje. Can you just tell us how these photos match up?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I take it it's my photos or our photos from the road leading from Bratunac towards Sandici-Konjevic Polje. I took the picture of the western door of Kravica warehouse. If you look at the, let's say, pillars -- no, just maybe not pillars, but the strips along the door, we see that they're the same strips.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sorry, you mean the vertical concrete strips?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, correct. Correct. If we look at the general picture of the Kravica warehouse and we compare with the footage from Studio B, it's visible that this is the same house. I believe the next witness, also an investigator, will explain more about the investigation related to this Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. That, I think, about --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could I see the slow-motion video again?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And I wonder whether you also have a split comparison video for this part?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We do not have a split video, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: May --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: But I will --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Please go on. I'm asking.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's very difficult to make this comparison part like we did with the white house. I will explain why. Because -- because in the raw footage, raw material, this is about 24 seconds recorded over, but, in fact, the footage of Studio B we have only few seconds, one or two seconds of Kravica warehouse and the bodies in front of it, but we couldn't locate exactly in which part. Definitely it was the part, these 24 seconds, recorded over in the raw footage where we see the ration package and the blank portion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The scene with people moving around, with music, it's already in the raw clipping, raw tape, and they are not ones that were -- the ones that have been recorded over.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's correct, Your Honour. This is the -- the clips where people are moving around, you know, on the horses, there are clips but recorded day after, it means on the 14th, and we have this material on -- on -- on raw -- on the raw material received from Mr. Pirocanac. We -- I believe if we played the raw material, we see the same clips later on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Shall we --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: But --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: -- the Studio B material is, of course, edited material. This was not possible to ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just to be clear, on the -- on the Studio B which is edited material, this Kravica warehouse clip appears -- I think you were saying it appears to be on the 14th of July, the next day of video shooting, not on the 13th when the -- when these killings took place.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you repeat your question, please?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm a bit confused.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes. It was a bad question. If one looks at the Studio B footage which has been edited, the brief clip that's there of the Kravica warehouse is mixed in with video -- other video that was shot on the 14th of July --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: -- is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. Before -- before Kravica clip we have the footage from the 14th July, and after -- just after we have the footage also from the 14th July.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. What I'd like you to do now is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could we play the slow video part again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, yes. Let's play that again, please, Mr. Reid. It's easier, I think, to play the whole clip than to find just the slow, the rapid first. It won't take long.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Blaszczyk, was this part filmed from inside the car, in your opinion?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, Your Honour. In my opinion it was -- it was done from inside the car.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And the car was moving from which to which direction?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The car was moving from Sandici towards Kravica/Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Although from Konjevic Polje to Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, is correct. Just with the last footage we saw the raw material is recorded on Sandici meadow and the car is moving from direction of Sandici-Konjevic Polje towards Bratunac, and Kravica is located about 900 metres from Sandici towards Bratunac. And definitely it has been recorded from the car.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can I see once again, if you don't mind.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, of course.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I'll ask my -- I'll ask the Defence this, we have a -- which may be helpful. We have a composite photo put together of the Kravica warehouse, the front of it, from the pan of the Studio B footage. In other words, we've taken the stills from the Studio B footage and pasted them together so you can see it all in one panoramic photo. It's not listed for use with Mr. Blaszczyk. I don't believe it has a 65 ter number, but I could bring that up. I think it might be helpful if there's no objection.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: We don't object, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, we grant it.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Thank you, Mr. Robinson. This is a photo with ERN number 07041106 and this was created by the OTP from the Petrovic/Studio B stills, and you can see that's why it has several Studio B logos on it. But that shows you what you see in the clip if you were able to see it not in a pan but in one photo, from the man in military uniform, police uniform on the far right, you can't quite see his face, to the back of the bus. This is what was shot from the moving car. And if I could tender that, Your Honour, if there's no objection. It would be --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We didn't hear the confirmation from the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I shouldn't be testifying.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you tell us what this is, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is a picture created by -- by us. This is compilation of the footage -- the stills from the Studio B segment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. That will be admitted.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit P4269, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And for the record, the 65 ter number for this would be 23585.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, before the break if you could now, and I think this is also helpful for the location of the warehouse and the surroundings, if we could go to the interactive CD as we call it, and if you could start off with Kravica and then show some of the other places we've seen in this clip, in this chapter of your book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I think we may need to switch the feed, whatever that means, to allow him to use the laptop.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I have problem. Okay. Okay. Your Honour, we are again in detailed map of the area of Bratunac and Srebrenica and Konjevic Polje. We are going to the segment related to Sandici portion of this -- our raw material and Studio B material. We are in more detailed map here. I marked here the several locations we can get in, and I marked also Kravica warehouse. As I said, if you would like to know which -- which part is linked to other photos and other stills you can always use the "Help" button. This is entire road where the action took place, in fact, in July 1995. Now we are going to Kravica warehouse. You did ask me about Kravica warehouse, yes?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Because we were just on Kravica warehouse, yeah, let's please start there and then we can look at some of the -- go along the road from Sandici where the film started. But let's begin at Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. We are in Kravica. That's getting in Kravica area. We have 360-degree view of Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you spin all the way around, please, so we can see how close the road is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is road leading us to -- okay. From the right-hand side to the left this is -- to the left this is Sandici meadow. On the right-hand side this is direction of Bratunac. This is the main road from where this footage from Studio B had been recorded. We are -- we are in the front of the western door of -- western part of the Kravica warehouse. We can get -- let's check first because it's not marked here, my mistake, but I should mark it. The activated field. It can be helpful. Not always. I put these -- unfortunately I put these yellow arrows. If we click on the door of the warehouse we see the picture from Studio B, the still from Studio B. The same location.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The west door.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. This is west door. Western part of the Kravica warehouse, exactly this. Before we go -- get in, also in this location we see in the footage from 1995, July 1995, 13 July 1995, we have the footage of the bus and the men walking along the bus. If we would like to go inside the Kravica warehouse to the west part of the Kravica warehouse, you have to click here and we are inside. We can move around. This is how it looked in 2006 in -- during our mission in May 2006.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was there a shed or kind of small building in this area in July 1995?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: One second. If you go closer it would be more visible, you know, because we are closer to the eastern part of this -- this part of premises. Your Honour, here we see the marks of small - how to say? - guarding house inside the -- this, this warehouse. One of the witness, I believe, is going to describe how he was hidden during the execution. And it does not exist anymore, you know, this guarding house, but we still see the marks of this guarding house. Very small one used by the guards who were by the counter.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just so we get an idea of the scale, have you measured the inside of this portion of the warehouse?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I did it by myself and also it was done in 1996 by our forensic team, I believe. This part, as far as I remember, is about 260 metres -- square metres, and another part, the eastern part of the Kravica warehouse had about -- has still about 300 square metres. We can go back to outside or going to the previous spot where we entered the Kravica in front of entrance. Then you can go out. We can check the view of the Kravica warehouse from different perspective, I mean, rather, from the eastern part. Here is the eastern part of the Kravica warehouse where the other people were kept also, the other group of the prisoners were kept. Further down. We are on the edge of the Kravica warehouse. We see entire -- not entire, but most of the compound of Kravica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just so we could see, if you pan back, the entrance would be behind this building from the main road; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. You are facing towards direction of Sandici. We are walking down. We are closer again. Sandici's not very visible here, but white destroyed house opposite the road it could be visible if we would have a better picture or better resolution of this picture. Somewhere here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And then if Their Honours have no questions, maybe now we could, just before the break, go to Sandici meadow and you can show us how the 360-CD works there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We are again at the map. Would you like me to start with Sandici meadow or with --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You could perhaps start with Sandici meadow and just quickly go through the sequence of the spots that are marked in the order we saw them in the video. In other words, heading towards Konjevic Polje and then coming back.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Let's have the general view of Sandici meadow and surrounding areas. Your Honour, we are on the hill above Sandici meadow. We see Sandici meadow in front of us. We see the white -- white destroyed house across -- located across the road from Sandici meadow. And I would like to show now the same location but also from the hill but from another hill, from the direction of Konjevic Polje. Just a second ago we were here. Let's go back again to the other hill and to have the overview of Sandici meadow surroundings. Then we can go to Sandici meadow. This is Sandici meadow. This is footage, of course, from raw material of Mr. Petrovic. General view again. We are on the west part of the destroyed white house across the road from Sandici meadow. We can follow the path used by the people who are surrendering to the Bosnian Serbs army.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So, Mr. Blaszczyk, Mr. Pirocanac filmed at Sandici meadow twice, on the way to the direction of Konjevic Polje and on his way back to the direction of Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's correct, Your Honour. It's correct. It's correct. Would you like me to follow the sequences of --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Oh, yes, please. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Let's come back here. I think the first footages we have that one. May I use the help of the book if you don't mind, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And that's right, Mr. Blaszczyk. This is really the first frame of this portion of the Petrovic video. It shows --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is exactly -- [Overlapping speakers]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: -- this man.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry. This is Sandici meadow. Here we have entire still from raw material of Mr. Petrovic. We see here member of Special Police Brigade, Sekovici Detachment. How this place looks now, how it looked in 2006.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do these people, Mr. Blaszczyk, appear in the second clip taken at the Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: You're referring to which -- sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It's people appearing on page 32 in the book.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That's the first shot filmed at Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, yes, yes. It's correct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Do they appear in the second clip at Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On the second portion of Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I think -- I have to check.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: But, yes, I think we have the -- yeah. At least we have the portion of this. It was captured, you know, the part of this group kept in Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So they are still there.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. They are still there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I note the time. Shall we take a break, or if you could show me that portion after the break.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I will.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We can --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall I allow the witness to communicate with Mr. Nicholls to show us that -- that clip?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. We don't mind.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honour, maybe this is not exactly the same clip, but the same area the people are visible in the meadow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I would like to see that portion after the break. We'll break for an hour and resume at 1.30. --- Luncheon recess taken at 12.30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. I would like to make an oral motion to strike a pleading that was filed today. If I could have a few minutes at the close of the day today to be heard on that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Are you referring to the Prosecution's response to your supplemental submission?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think our staff forgot to copy the e-mail to the Prosecution, but it was triggered by the Chamber's invitation. The Chamber wanted to hear from the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: I see. Okay. If we could be informed of that in the future we would appreciate that --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: -- but that's fine. Then in that case I won't make a motion. My point was that it appeared --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If it was filed, you are minded to withdraw it then.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. I didn't file any --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: No. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: -- motion. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. -- Mr. Nicholls, please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, what I'd like to do now is just to make it very precise about the filming, and clear, the filming on the 13th of July of Sandici meadow. Let's play the first clip again, where Mr. Petrovic began filming on the 13th, when he then headed towards Konjevic Polje, and then play the clip, the second clip, on the way back. Okay?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So I'll ask Mr. Reid to start playing right at the beginning of what we call chapter 2, "On the road," at 9 -- which begins on page 24 of the book.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. I've stopped there at 09:58.3. This again is the scene we see on page 26 now of the road book. It's quite close to the photograph marked C. Just to be clear, this is the beginning at Sandici meadow. Do I have that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. First we have the picture of -- yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now I ask Mr. Reid to move ahead to show this - we only see a part of the men here - to the second shot we have of Sandici meadow which is just after we see Mr. Borovcanin talking about swapping pistols. If we could go there, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. We're now at page 32, around photograph B.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Again, can you just confirm where this is and when this was taken, this group of men, which we also see in the interactive CD presentation.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is -- this picture, this shot is taken on Sandici meadow itself. We see the group of the prisoners, we see the group of the prisoners here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Now I'd like to play this again in slow motion starting from when the camera sweeps from Mr. Borovcanin and his companions to Sandici meadow and the men on the field. And, Mr. Blaszczyk, I'd like to ask you to focus on the very top left portion of the screen and see what you see there, something happening that -- I want to see your comment on it.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. And can we go back a few frames.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And what I'd ask you to look for is a man who appears to be falling down rapidly on the top left screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you notice what I was directing you to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Have you noticed that before in this segment?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I remember watching it, and we had some discussion, but it's difficult to say exactly what was going on there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And we don't hear any sound on this part of the video, do we, just where that happens?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, we don't.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I'd now like to ask Mr. Reid to show us the clip of Sandici meadow again, this time now on the return trip from the Konjevic Polje road, and this is at approximately the same section as at page 54 of the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'll just say now for the record we're starting at 23:28.5, yes. The man in the black jacket walking. You can play it, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If you could stop. We've stopped at 23:52.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That's the Sandici meadow bit of film we have on the way back. So can you tell us, Mr. Blaszczyk, again, if you answer the question His Honour the Presiding Judge asked you about, do we see the same -- what groups of men do we see going and coming back?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I was mistaken. You know, just we don't see the same group of the men standing in Sandici meadow because that camera didn't capture the Sandici meadow itself, the centre of Sandici meadow. We see only the men walking towards Sandici meadow carrying wounded or body of one of the men, or woman, man, and we can come to the conclusion that people were still gathering at Sandici meadow. Why? Because in previous footages we see that lot of people still coming down from the forest and going -- crossing the road and going across to Sandici meadow. But we don't see this footage of Sandici meadow in this -- in this raw material.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I mean we don't see the prisoners on the Sandici meadow on the way back when Mr. Pirocanac, together with Mr. Petrovic [sic], went back again to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. But we see that certain -- some people were still surrendering at this point of time.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. We see that some people still are surrendering at this point of time, but we don't see people gathering on the Sandici meadow. I believe this is because simply camera didn't catch this part of Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, now I'm done with those clips. If you could try to take us through on the video presentation starting at Sandici meadow. We already did Kravica, we don't need to do that again, but going through the trip that Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac and Borovcanin drove on that 13th July.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: May I start?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. We are again in the detailed map of the area of Sandici. Let's go to overlook on Sandici meadow itself and the surrounding areas. We remember that first foot -- footage in Sandici meadow is the footage of -- of Cop. I mean -- I'm referring to Cop because the nickname of the officer who is standing in front of us right now, bandanna man, his nickname is Cop. Next link showing us the area where Petrovic did his recording. Unfortunately I made again mistake. I didn't put the arrow here, but, Your Honour, if you -- if somebody would like to operate with this presentation, please click just in case this "Help" button here. You see, this is the blue -- blue field. This is linkage page to -- linkage to the still from Petrovic video. Again, it was somewhere here. Okay, I can be mistaken by 1, 2 metres, but no more.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, can I ask you to please just leave on that "Help" button while you're going through this so we can see where all those fields are.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The other fields are okay. You can see. Would you like me to keep this blue field?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: No. If that's the only one you can remove it.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And the next action recorded by Mr. Pirocanac is Mr. Borovcanin together with two brothers and swapping his pistols with them. Just watching the pistol. And here we have also the still from Petrovic raw material. We see -- we see here the tank, which was located on Sandici meadow, and we see also another part of the road, on another side of the road the BOV. I believe this is BOV used by the Special Police Brigade, and I believe this is also here, the car, the passenger car here, this is car belong to Mr. Borovcanin. This BOV is much better visible on -- I believe on the page 28 on the picture B, on the still from Petrovic raw material B, marked here as B. This is the same BOV that we see that Mr. Borovcanin and Petrovic following on the roads towards Pervani, Konjevic Polje. And then we see that the next -- next -- and, of course, we have the footage of the group of the people gathered at Sandici meadow. This is almost -- this is the same, in fact, picture from -- still from the page 32, picture, still, A. And also we see the roof of the car, the passenger car, with antenna on it. I believe this is the car of Mr. Borovcanin. We saw in the previous picture. We are coming to the most recent picture and now I would like to show you, Your Honour, the way which Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic together with the driver, they followed the APCs. They went towards Konjevic Polje. We are coming -- we are about 200 metres down from Sandici meadow towards -- we are heading now towards Konjevic Polje. Let's go back to the map now. And the first footage of -- of APCs recorded by Mr. Petrovic, this is in the area of Pervani. Again you can link to the image from Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can I just say then -- can I just say that, Mr. Blaszczyk, the link you've just shown us in Pervani, that's on -- those images are on page 34 of the road book; correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This is image from the page 34. And the -- these two APCs moved for a while towards Konjevic Polje, about 300 metres. To get this place we have to get it on to the map. It's exactly here. We are again on this place. Buildings to -- the picture from 1995. We see the footage from Petrovic video. This is the same footage as on page 36, footage -- image, sorry, D. And, Your Honour, at this point we have no more footage recorded behind this point towards Konjevic Polje. The first footage recorded by Mr. Pirocanac Petrovic on the way back, this is closer to Sandici meadow. I am back to the map. It's about 1.000 metres closer than the location at that time, these two APCs. This is one of the first footage recorded on the way back by Mr. Pirocanac Petrovic. This --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sorry, continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This entire page, you know, we don't see again here -- unfortunately, it's my mistake. We don't see again this arrow leading us to -- linking us to the footage from 1995, but this -- you can use the "Help" button or I can say, of course, that this entire picture is linked to this footage. And we can't get in.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just here we're at pages 38 and 39 of the map book; is that right? Of the road book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, correct. You will see if you -- if we get to the footage from 1995, Petrovic footage, we see the same picture. This is on the page 38. And then we see that Mr. Petrovic and Borovcanin, they are driving back to Sandici meadow. They're passing by the first wall. They are linked to the same location, but from 1995, July. This is direction to Sandici meadow. Another image of Petrovic video. And we are getting closer to -- to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. And the portion you've just described is on pages 40 and 41, is that right, of the road book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. This portion was on the page 40 and 41. Let's go back to the map. This is again overview of Sandici meadow and its surroundings. Let's go back. And if we are here, Mr. Borovcanin, Mr. Petrovic, they are using this road to getting Sandici meadow. Again, we are closer to Sandici. I would refer to -- to page 43 from the -- from my book. I believe this is the same picture. If we link to the -- to the picture from 1995, we see the same picture as is depicted on the page 42 as picture A. This man standing on the right-hand side of the road if you are heading towards Sandici. Mr. Borovcanin passing more soldiers crouching behind the barrier. This is also the same picture we have on the page 42, picture B. And next soldier visible on the page 42, picture C. And the last footage when he's coming out from the bench, in fact, is his picture D from page 42. Let's go back to the map. Your Honour, we were here exactly. If we go to this road, this road is leading to Konjevic Polje. We are exactly on opposite side of -- of this retaining wall. Let's go back. If we go to page 44, this is link to the footage from 1995, Petrovic footage. It's again one soldier standing behind a barrier looking forward, hills. And we know that Mr. Petrovic stopped here. He -- he recorded -- he recorded members of Jahorina Unit here. From the book this is page 46. This particular picture, this is picture A from page 46.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Sir, it's apparent from this video, according to your explanation, that Pirocanac made a stop before they reached the Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's correct. It's correct, Your Honour, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: He stopped -- in fact, he stopped just about 200 metres from Sandici meadow. He walked towards Sandici meadow. He stand behind the white destroyed house across the road from Sandici meadow, and they drove to -- towards Kravica.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you could just -- I think we're almost done. If you could just continue with the last couple links to show Their Honours what else is available on the CD.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course this is another link. Another Jahorina Unit member. We -- we are getting closer to Sandici meadow. Immediately we went to the footage from -- from Petrovic video, but let's go back little bit. It's more visible here. We have here link from the page -- I believe this is page -- picture from the page 52, the picture B. Just opposite of the road from Sandici meadow. Okay. Let's go back little bit. If, Your Honour, you remember probably the two members of the Jahorina Unit looking down to the screen -- to the creek, watching down. This is also footage from page 50, footage B. Let's go back to the overview of Sandici meadow and white destroyed house. And now we see that Mr. Petrovic is recording the events surrounding the destroyed white house across -- across the road.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Across the road from Sandici meadow?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, of course, this is across the road from Sandici meadow. We are looking at the west wall of the destroyed white house. We are across the road from Sandici meadow. We see the general view of the path used by the prisoners coming down from the hills and from the forest, passing the road and going to Sandici meadow. And if I zoom in a little bit, it's very hardly too visible, but from this location if we would be there, it's visible Kravica warehouse. It's somewhere here where I point now. And I mark here some links to the picture from -- from Petrovic video. The first one, I believe this is on page 56, still A. We see this man is coming using this path down here. And the footage was recorded just in front of him. We have next one. We have -- we have the group of the prisoners passing by the west wall of this destroyed white house, and it's very visible here are pillars -- one pillar of this white destroyed house. If we come closer to my picture, we see the same pillar here. And this is a picture from Petrovic video depicted on the page 56 of this road book as picture F. We have a link near the corner of destroyed white house, and this -- this is Petrovic footage image and is depicted in -- in my road book on the page 54. And we are back to -- we are back to the map, and -- yeah. We were already in Kravica, but we see -- we analyse and we are sure that - what was confirmed, by the way, by Mr. Petrovic as well - that they drove from this location towards Kravica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. What I'd like to do now, Mr. Blaszczyk, - this will go a little more quickly - is go through the remainder of the Petrovic video and chapters in your book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: So I'll ask Mr. Reid to start playing where we had left off, which was just after the end of the Sandici meadow return trip segment at around 23:48 or so. And think we need to switch a feed, please. All right. So we're starting again with the man in the black jacket who has just come around the corner of the white house, and we'll start playing there, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Can we stop here, please? Your Honour, this is not depicted in my road book, but this is obvious. We know it from Mr. Pirocanac and from other witnesses that we in the following day, on the 14th of July, 1995, and right now Mr. Borovcanin together Petrovic and his driver, of course, they are entering the enclave, Srebrenica enclave, and they are passing by UN check-point known for us as check-point Papa. I think.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let me say we're at 24:58.9.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is UN check-point when we are approaching enclave from Bratunac. It's near Zuti Most.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Continue, Mr. Reid.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I was going to stop you. It's 26:01.5. Mr. Blaszczyk, you had something to say about this point?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Your Honour, if you pay attention, this is footage depicted in the Studio B broadcast as the footage connected with Kravica warehouse incident. And it is visible that it was recorded on the following day, on the 14, not on the 13th [Realtime transcript read in error "15th"].

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So just to be clear, if I understand you, this video from the 14th of July that we're watching here, in the Studio B edited footage, it's at this point that we get to the Kravica warehouse clip with the bodies, which is absent from the raw footage.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct. THE PROSECUTOR: You can keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I've just stopped. It's at 27:25.7.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is not contained, this stop, in your road book. Can you just tell us who the big man is on the right side in the short-sleeved camouflage shirt?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Tomislav Kovac. He's Deputy Minister of Interior of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And do you know where this location is in Srebrenica -- or I should just say, where this location is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, this is in Srebrenica. Unfortunately we don't have the photo of this location. We've decided that it's not so important, but this is in the centre of Srebrenica, and in the front of the police station -- at that time police station in Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Keep playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. Can I ask you to go back a bit. And play.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At 27:38.9, that's a little bit fuzzy, but who is the man who just walked in front of Tomo Kovac?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This man is Dragomir Vasic. He was the head of CJB of Zvornik. THE PROSECUTOR: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I won't go back, but at 27:47.7, we just saw Mr. Borovcanin as well; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. We saw just Mr. Borovcanin again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Play, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop here. Could you go back little bit. Yeah. Could you stop. Okay. We don't have the picture of this police station in our road book here, but we see here also the department store in Srebrenica. It's called Srebrencanka at that time, and we have the picture of this -- this -- the same department store is depicted on page 64 of my road book. But we see [indiscernible] picture of the town, I believe.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We see the distance how far it is from the police station in Srebrenica. In fact, the picture does not reflect the exact distance, but it's more or less.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And before we move on, let me just say we were at approximately 28:10. We can play now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just stop for a minute at 30:54.4.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Nothing to do with this frame, but, Mr. Blaszczyk, do you recall whether Mr. Petrovic said that during this time in Srebrenica on the 14th of July that for a time he walked around by himself without Mr. Borovcanin and shot some video downtown?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could you repeat, please?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At some point on this trip on the 14th, do you know did Mr. Petrovic on his own take some video in Srebrenica when he wasn't with Mr. Borovcanin?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is one of the situation when he walk around Srebrenica without Mr. Borovcanin. At least we don't see Mr. Borovcanin. We don't see any -- we don't hear any conversation with Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Nicholls, could you check whether we have the transcript of this part in evidence. You can come back later.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It's P667, Your Honour. It's attached to the video. It should be in evidence. It was admitted as an associated exhibit with Mr. Petrovic's evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Together with the transcript.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I believe so, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I was asking because I couldn't find it from this Srebrenica trial video book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We can continue playing, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We're at 35:37.8. Just tell us what this image is, which is at page 64 of your map book, position 24 and 23.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are in the centre of Srebrenica. We see the department store located in the centre of Srebrenica in front of us. It's called Srebrencanka. At that time, on the right-hand side we see part of the municipality building in Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And from the video footage we've seen the apartment buildings. Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac was talking to some people outside the apartments, on the balconies. From your trips to Srebrenica, are you able to tell what vicinity we were in in relation to the department store and downtown?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's not -- not far away, just 100 metres, 150 metres, maybe.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. So what we've been seeing is downtown Srebrenica?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We can say it's downtown Srebrenica. Srebrenica is very small town and just to reach each place in Srebrenica we need only few minutes by walk.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop there, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you just tell us, it's not in your book, but what building is that, if you know?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know what exactly was there, but I see that is written there "Energoinvest Srebrenica," but this is building located next to municipality building of Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I stopped us at 36:22.2. Could we keep going.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop. Could we go back a little bit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We're at 37:42.2. We've stopped, and we'll play the video a bit more, but there's a corpse here, a dead man, and we'll see that there are a couple of other men here with him. Do you know this location in Srebrenica? Are you able to describe it?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I know this location very well. This is in -- also in the centre of Srebrenica, also located about 100, 150 metres maybe from the municipality building but from another side, not the same side like department store. And in this footage there are depicted three bodies, and we see the footage of one of the bodies. I believe we see the same body on the footage from recorded on the 12th of July, 1995, by the press centre officer in the centre of Srebrenica but in different -- different location, not far from -- from this location but little bit different location further down to -- to the south, in front of one house, storehouse, something like that. And this is -- this is the body, I believe, you know, just lying on the 12th in the centre of Srebrenica, near mosque.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Well, just a minute. Let me get to that. But you see here this man, the colour of his greying hair, the jacket and the blue jeans.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'd like to play another --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We have to remember, of course, that this -- this -- this footage was recorded on the 14, and the first footage of these men, I believe, we have on the 12th.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. I'd like to play a clip from the trial video from 12 July. This is P40201 coming up. It's from part 2 of the trial video, at the beginning of part 2. If Mr. Reid could play that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We've stopped here at 27.5, photo of a man with a lot of blood lying on his stomach, face down. Is this -- is this the video you were referring to? Do I have it right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct. You know, this is the video I referred just few seconds ago, and this is also I believe the man who we see on the Petrovic raw footage. If we look at his jacket, at his jeans, at his hair, I believe it's the same man.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And can you just tell us where we got this bit of video from that's shot from the 12th?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think right now this is the part of the trial video, but video itself we got -- we got from the seizure -- was seized at the apartment of Mr. Ratko Mladic. I don't remember whether it was the first search in 2008 or the second one, but I'm pretty sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please. We'll just finish this clip.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We stopped at 51.4. We can see a mosque with a minaret. Can you just tell us where we are in Srebrenica now approximately. If you can describe the location.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We are in the centre -- central square in Srebrenica in front of the central mosque.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll keep playing, we'll just finish this clip.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Could you stop here, please. And, Your Honour, the same body and together with two other bodies we see on the Petrovic raw material exactly behind this building visible on that right-hand side. This is, I think, ten-floors building over there and little bit deep over there and the bodies were visible there.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We're at 1:15.2. Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. You can stop. Now, if we can just go back to the Petrovic raw video footage. We're at the same point. Keep playing.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: May I say something, Your Honour?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. By all means, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: And, Your Honour, we believe that this body is the body of the man who was killed on 11 of July, 1995, in the centre of Srebrenica. These killings have been described by one of our witness, I believe. For sure this is Drazen Erdemovic. We believe this is the body of --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think this is not the subject of his evidence. We can continue.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It's hard to stop on exactly the right frame. We're at 39:35.2. Mr. Blaszczyk, did you notice the patch, the black patch on the left arm of the man in the middle as we were playing? We can play it a bit more.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, I did, of course. I watched this video several times and this is patch of Drina Wolves unit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You're familiar with that patch?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'm not sure if there's an error in the transcript. No. It's all right. My mistake, sorry. Keep playing.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And just to point out, Mr. Blaszczyk, 41:06.8, the date stamp has appeared, 14 July 1995. Just to ask again, is that the correct date when this footage was taken based on all of the evidence?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This is correct date. This is the date when this recording was done.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Continue, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, I wanted to ask you one question about the road, but before we continue to the next chapter, to Zeleni Jadar and the wood factory, on page 66 of your book there are two photos, A and B, that occur -- that were taken, I believe, later on in sequence on the video on the way back from Zeleni Jadar towards Bratunac. Can you tell us why you've put them in here at this spot?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was created this -- these photos, they are stills from the footage recorded on the way back from Zeleni Jadar by Mr. Pirocanac. I put this photo of Srebrenica in one place. I didn't want to create additional chapters, whatever. I didn't want to make this book quite complicated. And I put these photos in one chapter.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We can continue now, and we'll get to the next chapter, just getting closer to the end. Play, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Can we stop here? Your Honour, we are approaching -- in fact, Mr. Pirocanac is approaching Zeleni Jadar factory, wood factory, and if you notice some sandbags over there, this is check-point OP Echo, UN check-point, UN observation point.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And we'd stopped at about 42:36. If we can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We're at 42:46.8.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It's not exactly the same photo, but now this goes to page 70 of your map book in Zeleni Jadar. This is a closer-up photo of the building at page -- of photo A, page 70, map position 22. Can you just tell us where we are now and what this building is?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are in Zeleni Jadar, and this is a wood factory in Zeleni Jadar. On the left -- on the page 70 we see the footage from Petrovic video depicting this factory, the same factory, the same, in fact, part of the wall over there. And we have the picture of the same factory from -- taken in 2006 on page 71.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Keep playing, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We stopped now at 45:45.0. Nearly the same exact still we have before us is on page 70, B, in Zeleni Jadar. Just for the record, who are these three men now together that have now travelled to Zeleni Jadar from -- we saw earlier in Srebrenica that Mr. Petrovic is filming? Who are these three in the frame?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first man is Tomo Kovac, the Deputy Minister of Interior. The second man is Dragomir Vasic, the head of Zvornik CJB; and the last one is Ljubisa Borovcanin, the Deputy Commander of the Special Police Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can it be played, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Can we stop here? This is observation -- OP Echo, the former Dutch OP.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And we're at 46:31.5. Continue, please.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. We were -- I stopped us at 48.24.5. We're getting close to the end of his raw -- of Mr. Petrovic's raw footage. Can you tell us now, Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic Pirocanac are back in the car driving, where are they going and what is this we see where they've stopped for a minute?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are driving towards Srebrenica. We see the view of Srebrenica, of the hill above Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We're at 49:46.3. Could you tell us where we are here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are coming to the centre of Srebrenica, and this photo reflects the photo from my road book, from the page 66. This is two photos recorded by Mr. Pirocanac on the way back from Zeleni Jadar to Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And just to be clear, these are the ones which are slightly out of sequence because now coming back from Zeleni Jadar. If we could continue.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Can we stop here. Your Honour, on the left-hand side we are passing by UN compound, Company B compound in Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: How much more would you need to conclude, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Well, Your Honour, there's, I think, a little bit less than 10 minutes of video and then I have one discrete topic which is the -- talking a little bit about the Drina Corps collection and where it came from, what it is, which I think that part will take me 15 minutes or less, so in total about 25 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Why don't we continue tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can I draw your attention to transcript page of today 77, line -- from 2 to 5, referring to the footage recorded in Srebrenica town. This is Mr. Blaszczyk's response: "This is footage depicted in Studio B broadcast as footage connected with the Kravica warehouse. It is visible that it was recorded on the following day, the 14th, not on the 15th," but the transcript should read 13th, not 15th.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I think that is right, Your Honour, and I was going ask Mr. Blaszczyk about that later, but maybe he can tell us now if that's --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I noted he's nodding, but could you answer that question, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct, Your Honour. It should be read 13, not 15.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. And I have to correct myself, Mr. Robinson. It is not that our staff e-mailed the Prosecution but had a phone conversation when it is minded to respond. And on a separate note, the Chamber is seized of the accused's motion to compel the United Kingdom to produce certain documents. Given the novelty of the issue raised in that motion, the Chamber would appreciate if it could have the response from the Prosecution. Thank you. Can I ask how long it would take you to respond to that motion.

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I can get back to you. I appreciate that that is a question that asks us to get back in the earliest possible time, but I'll give you a more realistic appraisal if I can check our resources against our ongoing obligations, and I wouldn't want to promise anything right now unfairly to our staff as they're working on other matters.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll adjourn until tomorrow morning at 9.00. We will be sitting in regular format tomorrow, i.e., until 1.45. The hearing is now adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 26th day of January, 2012, at 9.00 a.m. 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 3.02 p.m.,
